source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.4, printed pages 225-229.

blocks.text: Bohat si beemariyan (disorders) respiratory system par asar dal kar saans ke amal mein rukawat banti hain. Yeh halki aur khud theek ho jane wali beemariyon, jaise aam zukam (common cold), se le kar sinusitis, otitis media, pneumonia, pulmonary tuberculosis, emphysema aur COPD jaisi sakht beemariyon tak hoti hain.
